Method

Margins are computed from the ledger, not estimated

SELECT segment,
  SUM(revenue) AS rev,
  SUM(op_income) / SUM(revenue) AS margin
FROM finance.gl_fy2024
GROUP BY segment;

Every figure in this deck traces to one governed table.

Restated FY23 figures use the same query.
